variants.name: 乌金藏朱
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand color exploration. EDIT the attached Chinese historical-game logo as the exact visual master chosen by the user. Preserve its five correct simplified Chinese characters "逆转五丈原", their original bespoke brush-calligraphic shapes, relative sizes, spacing, single-line horizontal layout, airy curved strokes of 逆转, long tapered terminals and robust 五丈原. Preserve the selected version's tangible shallow ink-black and rubbed gilding material, with subtle grain, elegant brush edge erosion and controlled shallow depth. Do NOT substitute the later flat pale version. User requests more color variants mainly YELLOW/GOLD, RED, BLACK. Make a deliberate sophisticated three-color art direction, not a rainbow or uniformly recolored font. Exact characters only, no named font, no borrowed commercial logo, no new text, no pictograms, no seal. All color must stay INSIDE the lettering silhouette and its existing thin sculpted edges. Keep black perimeter no thicker than the source; no exaggerated thick added outline or bulky extrusion. Gold is satin warm yellow gold with fine rubbed surface, not glitter, chrome or plastic. Red is rich Chinese vermilion or dark cinnabar, not neon orange or pink. Black is deep carbon-black with readable warm charcoal texture. Preserve transparent negative spaces and actual transparent background. ONE logo per image, landscape aspect approximately 3:1, complete lettering safely inside frame with clear padding. No black background rectangle, paper, scene, frame, glow, fire, particles, watermark, label or comparison sheet. Variant 01, closest to reference: overall about 55% warm gold, 30% black, 15% dark vermilion. Keep 逆转 black bodies with broad warm-gold strokes on their raised front planes; 五丈原 mainly golden. Introduce rich dark cinnabar into selected lower stroke surfaces and the long returning calligraphic tails, showing like old red lacquer beneath rubbed gold. Red is visible and purposeful, especially at the bottom of 逆转 and tips of 丈原, but stays subordinate. Rich black-gold with a hidden warm red layer.
